messages.subject: Issue with control.fixed parameter
parts:
Hi,

Hope you are well.

I am running the latest testing version (23.11.26) on R4.3.

I’m having difficulty with the results when using the control.fixed parameter.

Below is a simple example where I set the prior mean of the variable x to 1 and the precision to be a very high value. I would expect the mean of x in the output to be close to its prior value given the precision is high. However, the below output indicates the mean value of x tends to 0 not 1.

Is there something simple in my code I am missing or have I got the incorrect understanding of the maths/package? I have attached the verbose output for reference

Thanks for your help in advance.

# Random Data
df <- data.frame(
  y = abs(rnorm(100)),
  x = abs(rnorm(100,mean = 1)),
  z = abs(rnorm(100))
)




# INLA with prior mean of 1 & prior precision very precise
m <- INLA::inla(formula = y ~ x + z,
                data = df,
           control.fixed = list(mean = list(x = 1),
                                prec = list(x = 1e15)),
           verbose = TRUE
)

           


# X Tends to Zero & not to 1 as expected
summary(m)
